text.15:14: And even if We opened unto them a gate of heaven and they kept mounting through it,
text.16:58: When if one of them receiveth tidings of the birth of a female, his face remaineth darkened, and he is wroth inwardly.
text.20:97: (Moses) said: Then go! and lo! in this life it is for thee to say: Touch me not! and lo! there is for thee a tryst thou canst not break. Now look upon thy god of which thou hast remained a votary. Verily we will burn it and will scatter its dust over the sea.
text.26:4: If We will, We can send down on them from the sky a portent so that their necks would remain bowed before it.
text.26:71: They said: We worship idols, and are ever devoted unto them.
text.30:51: And if We sent a wind and they beheld it yellow, they verily would still continue in their disbelief.
text.42:33: If He will He calmeth the wind so that they keep still upon its surface - Lo! herein verily are signs for every steadfast grateful (heart). -
text.43:17: And if one of them hath tidings of that which he likeneth to the Beneficent One, his countenance becometh black and he is full of inward rage.
text.56:65: If We willed, We verily could make it chaff, then would ye cease not to exclaim:
